questionSnapshot.question: In Wreck-It Ralph, what is the name of the candy-themed racing game?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. A generic candy-themed description cannot establish a proper title by itself. Read D23’s attraction-story introduction naming the game and corroborated its game type with original-film synopsis.
